title: Pure Obelisk the Tormentor
summary: Pure Obelisk the Tormentor focuses on summoning Seto Kaiba's 4000 ATK/DEF DIVINE colossus—which cannot be targeted by card effects—and unleashing its signature board-wiping moves: Fist of Fate and Soul Energy MAX!!! Reveal Obelisk in your hand to Special Summon Angel O1 (granting an extra Tribute Summon), generate 3-Tribute fodder with Reactor Slime and Egyptian God Slime, or Tribute 3 of your opponent's own monsters during either Main Phase with Soul Crossing! Once Obelisk hits the field (or is revived during the Battle Phase via The Breaking Ruin God), Fist of Fate negates an opposing monster and wipes their backrow at Spell Speed 4, while Soul Energy MAX!!! tributes 2 monsters to destroy all monsters your opponent controls and burn them for 4000 damage!

allow.Metal Reflect Slime: Continuous Trap Monster Set directly from your Deck by Reactor Slime that summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK / 3000 DEF, immediately transforming into Egyptian God Slime (which counts as 3 Tributes for Obelisk the Tormentor!).
allow.Mound of the Bound Creator: Field Spell that protects Level 10 Obelisk the Tormentor from being destroyed by card effects, burns for 1000 when Obelisk destroys a monster by battle, and searches Obelisk the Tormentor from your Deck when destroyed!

main: Obelisk the Tormentor

Signature Level 10 DIVINE Divine-Beast boss (4000 ATK / 4000 DEF): its Normal Summon cannot be negated; cards and effects cannot be activated when Normal Summoned; cannot be targeted by card effects; and tributes 2 monsters to destroy all monsters your opponent controls!
Reactor Slime

Core starter: Special Summons 2 Slime Tokens during your Main Phase (assembling 3 Tributes alongside itself!), and tributes itself during the Battle Phase to Set Metal Reflect Slime directly from your Deck so it can be activated that turn.
Guardian Slime
Special Summons itself from your hand when you take damage, gains DEF equal to the attacking monster's ATK, and tributes itself on the field to Special Summon Egyptian God Slime.
Angel O1

Level 1 Fairy that reveals Obelisk the Tormentor in your hand to Special Summon itself from your hand, and while on field grants an additional Tribute Summon of a Level 7+ monster in Attack Position each turn!
Soul Crossing
Core Quick-Play Spell: during the Main Phase, Tribute Summons 1 Divine-Beast monster (Obelisk the Tormentor!) by Tributing monsters from EITHER field, including your opponent's monsters!
Fist of Fate

Signature Quick-Play Spell: its activation and effect cannot be negated; while you control Obelisk, negates 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls and destroys it, then destroys ALL Spells and Traps your opponent controls!
The Breaking Ruin God
Signature Quick-Play Spell: its activation and effect cannot be negated; Special Summons 1 'Obelisk the Tormentor' from your hand or GY unaffected by your opponent's card effects this turn!
Mound of the Bound Creator
Field Spell that makes Level 10 Obelisk the Tormentor indestructible by card effects and searches Obelisk from your Deck if destroyed.
Soul Energy MAX!!!

Signature Normal Trap: while you control Obelisk the Tormentor, tributes 2 other face-up monsters to destroy ALL monsters your opponent controls and inflict 4000 burn damage; banishes itself from the GY to search Obelisk from your Deck/GY and immediately Normal Summon it!
Metal Reflect Slime
Set directly from your Deck by Reactor Slime; summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK to tribute for Egyptian God Slime.
extra: Level 10 WATER Aqua Fusion boss (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summoned by Tributing a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK (Guardian Slime or Metal Reflect Slime); cannot be destroyed by battle, protects your other monsters, and can be treated as 1 OR 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of Obelisk the Tormentor!
